summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Roundhill Uranium ETF (UX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in uranium commodities. The fund seeks to provide exposure to the spot price of physical uranium through investments in swaps. The fund invests via a subsidiary that holds the contracts. UX was launched on Jan 29, 2025 and is issued by Roundhill.
